svg.title: VYBEIN R-HWS fragrance profile
svg.desc: An arch-shaped VYBEIN R-HWS scent profile with its 50 ml perfume, main accords, photographs of Bergamot, Apple, Aquatic accords, Ambergris, and an 8.5-hour longevity detail.
svg.text: Crisp fruits and aquatic freshness finish with soft amber warmth.
